text:
Residents:
Yuki (50s, WFH): Weekdays 9:00-17:30 at desk_b1. Often out for lunch (phone leaves house). Hobbies: gym, running, friends.
Nora (40s, Office): Weekdays out ~8:00-17:30. Home evenings. Hobbies: napping, reading, sketching. Cares for dog.
Weekends: Both sleep in. Errands around midday (12:00-16:00). Home the rest of the day.
*Note: Thursday was an exception; Nora was home sick all day.*

Object Locations & Movements:
Static Items:
- Balcony: Watering can on floor.
- Bathroom: Razor on sink; towels on rack.
- Bedroom 1 (Yuki): Desk has laptop, pen. Nightstand has book, tablet, charger. Wardrobe empty.
- Bedroom 2 (Nora): Desk has pencil case, sketchbook. Nightstand has book.
- Entry: Doormat, vacuum on floor. Hat on hook. Running shoes on rack.
- Kitchen: Dog bowl on floor.
- Living: Standard furniture items.

Dynamic Items (Saturday Update):
At 00:00, both residents home. Kitchen items (mugs, glasses, plates, bowls) moved from tables to sink/cupboards/dish rack. Phones returned to nightstands.
At 08:00, Yuki and Nora home. Dog food bag moved to floor. Nora’s shoes moved to entry floor.
At 12:00, Nora left for errands. Taken OUT_OF_HOUSE: backpack, jacket, keys, phone, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet. Yuki home; tablet to nightstand.
At 16:00, Nora returned home. Items returned: backpack, jacket, keys, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet. Yuki left for errands. Taken OUT_OF_HOUSE: hat, jacket, keys, scarf, shoes, wallet.
At 20:00, Yuki returned home. Items returned: hat, jacket, keys, scarf, shoes, wallet. Gym bag moved to entry hook. Kitchen items (knife, pan, pot, spatula) moved to sink.

Current Status (Sat 23:59):
- Yuki: Home. Items in usual spots.
- Nora: Home. Items in usual spots.
- Dog: Home.

Notes:
- Yuki’s routine: Takes phone when leaving for lunch/work. Returns in evening. On weekends, takes personal items (hat, jacket, keys, scarf, shoes, wallet) out for midday errands.
- Nora’s routine: Takes work items (laptop, backpack, lunchbox, etc.) to office on weekdays. On weekends, takes personal items (backpack, jacket, keys, phone, scarf, shoes, sunglasses, wallet) out for midday errands.
- Dog leash: Shared. Taken out by Yuki on Wed, Nora on Thu (08:00).
- Phone: Yuki’s phone was missing 08:00-12:00 on Friday. Likely taken by Yuki for lunch/errand or with Nora.
